steps.note: Open the single-stage creation flow specified by the case.
Enable eRFX-related event creation for the test company.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Configure a price-based reverse auction with whole-lot awarding.
Provide the mandatory event title without replacing the automatically generated test title with an invented value.
Apply the first available auction pricing template.
Add the specified product and quantity.
Populate the required pricing-sheet fields so the event can be published.
Set the requested delivery location on the first line item.
Invite three QA vendors for the A, B, and C participant setup without inventing company names.
Commit the 30-minute schedule with the event starting now.
Publish the configured auction.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Submit Vendor A's initial bid at 100.
Confirm the first vendor bid was accepted.
Submit a different vendor's bid at 95 to establish the visible best price.
Confirm the second vendor bid was accepted.
Verify the buyer's Responses view shows both direct vendor bids.
Open the available QA vendor's supplier-portal session.
Open the auction pricing sheet in the vendor portal.
Verify the vendor portal displays the current best price of 95.

args.need: open a second invited vendor's separate supplier-portal session, open this auction during bidding, and verify that it shows the best price 95 without identifying the vendor who placed it

steps.note: The catalog cannot create or control a second vendor's independent supplier session or fully assert anonymous price ownership.
Return to the available vendor portal session to test a valid lower revision.
Reopen the event's pricing sheet before the revised bid.
Submit a valid bid below the vendor's own 100 bid and below the current best price of 95.
Confirm the lower revised bid was accepted.
